sources.used_for: Keep daily grazing footprint separate from movement between bases. Regional lattice and movement budgets are declared tests, not calibrated ancient movement distances.

sources.title: Grain storage techniques: Factors influencing the choice of bulk store
sources.access: Primary manual's storage sizing and deterioration discussion read
sources.used_for: Separate short harvest receipt periods, dispatch schedules and finite buffer capacity. Neither 90/365 days nor 5% decay is claimed as a measured ancient value.

protocol: Keep all four earlier anchors, herd demand, fine-cell grazing area, intake, feed reserve and two-day movement limit fixed. Increase extent from five to twenty fine cells. Retain every reachable original local base, then add a stride-four outer lattice and a nested diagonal offset. Thus local, sparse outer and additional outer tests keep prior feasible choices. Stronger fixed-base and optimistic resource-only controls examine every home-connected fine cell, not only candidate bases. No outcome-based anchor or parameter changes.
